package mapper_test

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"github.com/kuangshp/gorm-plus/decimaljson"
	"github.com/kuangshp/gorm-plus/validation"
	"github.com/zeromicro/go-zero/rest/httpx"
	"gorm.io/driver/sqlite"
	"gorm.io/gorm"
	apiproto "jsonfixture/internal/apiproto"
	"jsonfixture/internal/mapper"
	"jsonfixture/internal/pb"
	"jsonfixture/internal/types"
	"jsonfixture/model"
)

func TestJSONGoZeroRoundTrip(t *testing.T) { // 经真实 HTTP 解析器、数据库和 RPC 边界验证 JSON 字符串不重复编码或损失精度。
	db, err := gorm.Open(sqlite.Open(filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "json.db")))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	pool, _ := db.DB()
	t.Cleanup(func() { pool.Close() })
	if err := db.AutoMigrate(&model.SamplesEntity{}); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	m, rpc := mapper.NewSamplesMapper(), apiproto.NewSamplesMapper()
	for _, raw := range []string{`{"id":9007199254740993,"nested":{"amount":12.34567890123456789},"list":[true,null,"红色"]}`, `[1,2,{"x":true}]`, `{}`, `[]`, `null`, `"hello"`} {
		t.Run(raw, func(t *testing.T) {
			body, err := json.Marshal(map[string]string{"name": "test", "attributes": raw, "metadata": `{"ok":true}`})
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			r := httptest.NewRequest("POST", "/", strings.NewReader(string(body)))
			r.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
			var req types.CreateSamplesReq
			if err := decimaljson.PrepareRequest(r, &req); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if err := httpx.Parse(r, &req); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if err := validation.Validate(&req); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if req.Attributes != raw || req.Metadata != `{"ok":true}` {
				t.Fatalf("parsed strings changed: %+v", req)
			}
			entity := m.DtoToEntity(&req)
			if string(entity.Attributes) != raw {
				t.Fatalf("database JSON encoded twice: %s", entity.Attributes)
			}
			if err := db.Create(entity).Error; err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			var loaded model.SamplesEntity
			if err := db.First(&loaded, entity.ID).Error; err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			response, err := json.Marshal(m.EntityToVO(&loaded))
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			check := func(response []byte) {
				t.Helper()
				var fields map[string]json.RawMessage
				if err := json.Unmarshal(response, &fields); err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
				var got string
				if err := json.Unmarshal(fields["attributes"], &got); err != nil {
					t.Fatalf("response must contain a string: %s, %v", response, err)
				}
				if got != raw {
					t.Fatalf("JSON string changed: want %q got %s", raw, response)
				}
			}
			check(response)
			message, err := rpc.CreateReqToProto(&req)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if message.Attributes == nil || *message.Attributes != raw {
				t.Fatalf("RPC string encoded twice: %+v", message)
			}
			response, err = json.Marshal(rpc.ProtoToVO(&pb.SamplesModel{Attributes: *message.Attributes, Metadata: *message.Metadata}))
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			check(response)
			modified, err := rpc.ModifyReqToProto(&types.ModifySamplesReq{CreateSamplesReq: req})
			if err != nil || modified.Attributes == nil || *modified.Attributes != raw {
				t.Fatalf("modify RPC string: %+v, %v", modified, err)
			}
			page, err := rpc.PageReqToProto(&types.PageSamplesReq{Attributes: req.Attributes})
			if err != nil || page.Attributes == nil || *page.Attributes != raw {
				t.Fatalf("page RPC string: %+v, %v", page, err)
			}
		})
	}
	if response := rpc.ProtoToVO(&pb.SamplesModel{}); response.Attributes != "" || response.Metadata != "" {
		t.Fatalf("empty RPC string changed: %+v", response)
	}
}

func TestJSONGoZeroStringParsing(t *testing.T) { // 原生解析支持 JSON 字符串，必填、可选和内部 JSON 语法仍按生成规则校验。
	parse := func(body string) (*types.CreateSamplesReq, error) {
		r := httptest.NewRequest("POST", "/", strings.NewReader(body))
		r.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
		var req types.CreateSamplesReq
		if err := httpx.Parse(r, &req); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		if err := validation.Validate(&req); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		return &req, nil
	}
	for _, body := range []string{
		`{"name":"native","attributes":"{}"}`,
		`{"name":"native","attributes":"{}","metadata":""}`,
		`{"name":"native","attributes":"{}","metadata":null}`,
	} {
		if req, err := parse(body); err != nil || req.Attributes != "{}" || req.Metadata != "" {
			t.Fatalf("native string parser: %+v, %v", req, err)
		}
	}
	// 纯数字 JSON 只验证边界转换，SQLite JSONB 的数值亲和性会改变数据库返回类型。
	req, err := parse(`{"name":"scalar","attributes":"9007199254740993"}`)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	m, rpc := mapper.NewSamplesMapper(), apiproto.NewSamplesMapper()
	if response := m.EntityToVO(m.DtoToEntity(req)); response.Attributes != "9007199254740993" {
		t.Fatalf("scalar JSON text changed: %+v", response)
	}
	message, err := rpc.CreateReqToProto(req)
	if err != nil || message.Attributes == nil || *message.Attributes != "9007199254740993" {
		t.Fatalf("scalar RPC text changed: %+v, %v", message, err)
	}
	if response := rpc.ProtoToVO(&pb.SamplesModel{Attributes: *message.Attributes}); response.Attributes != "9007199254740993" {
		t.Fatalf("scalar RPC response changed: %+v", response)
	}
	for _, body := range []string{
		`{"name":"invalid"}`,
		`{"name":"invalid","attributes":""}`,
		`{"name":"invalid","attributes":null}`,
		`{"name":"invalid","attributes":{"color":"red"}}`,
		`{"name":"invalid","attributes":[1,2]}`,
		`{"name":"invalid","attributes":"{bad}"}`,
		`{"name":"invalid","attributes":"{}","metadata":"{bad}"}`,
	} {
		if _, err := parse(body); err == nil {
			t.Fatalf("accepted invalid string request: %s", body)
		}
	}
}
